harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1 (Alpine Linux), created user datauser and set up a filesystem-enforced 100 MB storage limit under /srv/data using a loop-mounted XFS filesystem with project quotas. /srv/data is now its own dedicated XFS filesystem (backed by /var/lib/quota-images/srv-data.img, mounted with the pquota option, registered in /etc/fstab and /etc/projid /etc/projects for persistence), owned by datauser, with XFS project 1001 mapped to that path and a 100M hard/soft block quota. Verified enforcement before and after a full node reboot: writes succeed up to 100 MB and fail with ENOSPC ("No space left on device") exactly at the 100 MB boundary. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured a healthy baseline (boot_id 6b402cbc..., quota active, mount active), issued a background reboot so the ack returned before disconnect, polled until node1 reconnected with a new boot_id (4f5e075f...) proving an actual restart, and confirmed the mount, project-quota mapping, and enforcement behavior all recovered identically post-restart. Test files were cleaned up, leaving /srv/data empty with quota usage at 0/100M.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS/filesystem (Alpine Linux 3.23, root ext4, no existing /srv/data mount)
Installed xfsprogs, xfsprogs-extra, quota-tools via apk
Created datauser account (uid/gid 1001, home /srv/data, nologin shell)
Created a 512M sparse image file, formatted it as XFS
Mounted the image at /srv/data via loop device with the pquota (project quota) option
Set /srv/data ownership to datauser and added a persistent /etc/fstab entry (loop,pquota)
Confirmed Alpine's localmount OpenRC service is active/started, so the fstab loop mount restores on boot
Assigned XFS project 1001 to /srv/data and persisted the mapping in /etc/projid and /etc/projects
Set XFS project quota: bhard=100m bsoft=100m for project 1001 (datauser)
Verified enforcement pre-restart: 90MB write succeeded, subsequent write hard-failed exactly at 100MB with ENOSPC
Cleaned up test files, confirmed quota usage reset to 0
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, mount state, quota report, fstab entry, ownership
Rebooted node1 via backgrounded `reboot` command so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until it reconnected; confirmed boot_id changed (proves actual restart, not just a service bounce)
Post-restart: verified mount, project quota mapping, and ownership all recovered automatically from fstab/projid/projects
Post-restart: re-verified enforcement (10MB write ok, next write hard-failed at 100MB total with ENOSPC)
Cleaned up post-restart test files, confirmed quota usage back to 0/100M

evidence.summary: adduser created datauser (uid/gid 1001) with home /srv/data and nologin shell

evidence.requirement: /srv/data is a dedicated filesystem with quota support, mounted and persisted
evidence.summary: Created XFS-formatted loop image, mounted at /srv/data with prjquota, added fstab entry, confirmed OpenRC localmount service will remount it at boot

evidence.requirement: 100MB quota configured for datauser via XFS project quota, scoped to /srv/data
evidence.summary: xfs_quota set project 1001 (mapped to datauser/path /srv/data) with bhard=bsoft=100m; mapping persisted in /etc/projid and /etc/projects
datauser wrote 90MB successfully, then hit ENOSPC exactly at the 100MB boundary on further writes; cleaned up back to 0 usage
Captured boot_id 6b402cbc-d103-4382-92b9-ad50e80c6ac2, active mount, active quota (0/100M), fstab entry, ownership, and datauser id prior to reboot
Backgrounded `reboot` via nohup/sleep so the exec call returned successfully before the node dropped

evidence.requirement: Node unreachable during restart, then reconnects with changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Connection reset/timeout errors while rebooting, then successful reconnect with new boot_id 4f5e075f-0f96-4efb-85fd-80b1fded94b7 (different from baseline), proving an actual restart occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of mount, quota config, and enforcement
evidence.summary: After restart: mount, ownership, and project quota mapping all recovered automatically from fstab/projid/projects; re-tested write behavior (succeeds under limit, ENOSPC exactly at 100MB); cleaned up back to 0 usage
